  --a-out /data/xhw/vgcpod_v1_runs/roundA_20261019 \
  --c-out /data/xhw/vgcpod_v1_runs/roundC_20261020 \
  --d-out /data/xhw/vgcpod_v1_runs/roundD_20261020 \
  --e-out /data/xhw/vgcpod_v1_runs/roundE_20261020
